text:
[LCDB.3.3.1] Cooldown is keyed by the **declared `key` slots** of
each `logical` fact the activation binds (per [LFAC.1.7]) — not
by every bound slot. The same rule matching different entities
cools independently — "don't spam me about the
same sensor" doesn't mean "don't tell me about a different
sensor." Keying on the declared key excludes volatile `mutable`
slots (a churning `ts`) from the cooldown key, so a payload
change does not reset the cooldown.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_1__key_ignores_the_payload
idris.note: THE KEY IGNORES THE PAYLOAD: for a single-pattern rule over a logical schema the key of the bound fact is the same for any payload, so a mutable churn resets no window. A TRANSCRIPTION of `lcdb_3_3_1__key_of_head`, `Refl` over every id, key and payload.

idris.name: lcdb_3_3_1__key_of_head
idris.note: The key of a single-pattern rule over a logical schema: the bound fact's identity key -- the model's `fkey`, the code of the declared `key` slots -- and nothing of its payload.
